visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a fair complexion sits on a black stool in an indoor setting filled with cardboard boxes. She wears an oversized white cable-knit sweater vest over a light-colored long-sleeve shirt, paired with black tights and brown boots. She holds a smartphone and looks towards the camera with a surprised and then smiling expression. (2) The scene shifts slightly as she gestures with her hands while talking. Various animated graphics and text overlays appear around her, including a cartoon illustration of a pregnant woman and food items. She maintains high eye contact with the lens, using expressive facial movements. (3) An insert shows a bowl of pork cutlet curry on a wooden table, followed by a digital weight scale displaying '46.9'. The woman then appears holding a small jelly strip, bringing it to her mouth. Floating icons of corn, tea leaves, and fruit appear on the screen. (4) Split-screen and full-screen montages show the woman in different outfits (a pink cardigan, a grey gym set) highlighting her midriff. Before-and-after style photos and videos show her belly at different stages of postpartum recovery. (5) The woman returns to the original seat, holding a large red box of 'Hsinyen' branded fruit jelly. She waves to the camera. (6) The video concludes with a sequence showing a website interface with various product deals and a social media profile page, with the woman pointing towards the top of the frame.
